title: Mahjong Pairs
description: Slide rows and columns of classic mahjong tiles to line up matching pairs and clear every tile from the board.
controls: Tap adjacent matching tiles or drag a row/column to slide tiles together and eliminate matching pairs.

zh-CN.title: 雀神对对消
zh-CN.description: 推动麻将牌行或列，让相同牌面相邻并成对消除，巧用洗牌与提示清空整盘。
zh-CN.controls: 点击相邻的两张相同麻将直接消除，或拖动整行/整列推牌对齐后消除。
